name: Replika
tagline: AI companion app for everyday conversation, reflection and emotional support, with voice calls and a customizable avatar.
exclusion_reason: Owner decision needed on the child-safety exclusion rule. The Italian Garante fined Luka EUR 5M (May 2025) and found Replika 'had no age-verification system to restrict children'. It had suspended the service in Italy in Feb 2023 over risks to children. US senators also wrote to the CEO in April 2025 about child safety. Terms are otherwise compliant (18+ only, porn banned, real-person impersonation banned).
source_field: terms (18+, operator Luka Inc., 490 Post St San Francisco, CA law; obscene/pornographic content and real-person impersonation prohibited)
notes: nsfw_allowed=no comes from the terms ban on obscene/pornographic content. The App Store listing (Luka, Inc.) shows several monthly prices ($7.99, $14.99), and $7.99 is the lowest. The free tier is not confirmed on a pricing page. Google Play rates it Teen and the App Store rates it 18+. Web app is 'Legacy' (my.replika.com). Terms last updated 2026-10-28.

name: Chai

US senators wrote to Chai's CEO in April 2025 about child safety, citing consumer protection complaints over safety risks (https://www.welch.senate.gov/welch-padilla-probe-ai-chatbot-apps-on-safeguards-for-children). Australia's eSafety guide flags unprompted sexual and violent content (https://www.esafety.gov.au/key-topics/esafety-guide/chai-ai).
source_field: terms/EULA (strictly 18+, operator Chai Research Corp., 555 Hamilton Ave Ste 300 Palo Alto; adult roleplay allowed for adults; explicit images, minors and real-person sexual content/deepfakes banned)
notes: nsfw_allowed=yes means adult roleplay text for adults is allowed (EULA §8); explicit images are banned (§7.1). Google Play rates it 18+. Google Play links a privacy policy on gitlab.io that names 'Nexus, doing business as chai' (UK), which conflicts with the official chai-research.com privacy page (Delaware corp). eSafety describes it as a paid service with a free trial; no pricing page was found.
